findings.description: Nit: Clarify in contracts/README.md that the escalation resolutions list is returned by ExecutionAdapter.route_parked_escalations rather than modifying ExecutionAdapter.apply.
findings.resolution: Update contracts/README.md to explicitly state that ExecutionAdapter.apply return keys remain strictly unchanged and that the bounded escalation resolutions list is returned by ExecutionAdapter.route_parked_escalations.

findings.description: Optional: Clarify advisory lock scoping for ExecutionAdapter.route_parked_escalations to prevent flock non-reentrancy.
findings.resolution: Document that ExecutionAdapter.route_parked_escalations should rely on per-resume atomic serialization inside ExecutionAdapter.resume or manage advisory locks without nesting @_serialized_transition decorator calls.

findings.description: FYI: Bounded escalation resolution summaries provide clean, transcript-free progress reporting for host execution loops.
findings.resolution: Retain the proposed resolution structure containing dispatch_id, outcome, and pending gate entry or resume result without exposing child transcript content.

findings.description: Post-persist routing boundary guarantees that routing failures cannot cause dispatch_fn side-effect replay.
findings.resolution: Proceed with design D5 as specified.
